bifrost: No SDK module. Ad hoc equivalents: springboard/render/src/gfx/rotate.rs, springboard/src/media/convert.rs, springboard/apps/daw/src/conv.rs, springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/inflate.rs, springboard/src/shell/photos/edit.rs
summary: Accelerate's vector, signal, linear algebra, sparse solver and ML APIs have no BifrOSt SDK counterpart. DEFLATE and zlib are available to apps through the SDK compression module. The system and apps contain private equivalents (quarter-turn rotation, YUV to RGBA conversion, a radix-2 FFT convolver, brightness and contrast lookup tables), but no app can call them through the SDK.

features.feature: vDSP vector arithmetic and stride operations
features.apple: vDSP (vector-vector and vector-scalar operations, strided access, interpolation, decimation)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 2 (theme-36, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No public vector arithmetic API. The only resampler is private to the AAC decoder.

features.apple: vDSP Fourier transforms, Discrete Cosine transforms, fast Fourier transforms
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 3 (theme-27, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The FFT is app-local to the DAW convolver. No SDK transform API and no DCT.

features.apple: vImage convolution kernels, dilation and erosion (Convolution, Morphology collections)
features.note: Blur exists for materials. No general kernel convolution, dilation or erosion.

features.apple: vImage geometric transforms (rotate, reflect, shear, scale) and resampling
features.note: Quarter-turn rotation and a resample for emoji only. No shear, arbitrary-angle transform, or Lanczos resampling API.

features.apple: vImage alpha blending and blend modes
features.note: Source-over alpha blend is tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-04.rs (transparent, opaque and half alpha, and the monotonic red over black). No blend-mode set and no SDK-level image compositing.

features.apple: vImage convert-any-to-any (CMYK, planar and interleaved formats, YUV and RGB)
features.note: Wave 5 (w5-accelerate, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. NV12 and RGBA to premultiplied RGBA for the video thread. No CMYK, no grayscale conversion, and no public conversion API.

features.apple: vImage gamma, tone curves, histogram calculation, specification and equalization
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/photos/edit.rs:287 (per-channel lookup table: contrast then brightness)
features.note: A brightness and contrast lookup table inside the Photos app. No histogram, equalization or tone-curve API.

features.apple: Compression (buffer, stream and filter APIs), Directories and Data Archives
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/compression.rs (encode_buffer, encode_buffer_threaded, decode_buffer), springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/inflate.rs:251 (zlib), springboard/src/pngenc.rs:31 (zlib_stored, stored blocks only)
features.note: DEFLATE and zlib encode and decode through the SDK compression module (bifrost_app::compression); the PNG writer still emits uncompressed blocks, and no LZFSE, LZ4, LZMA or Brotli codec exists. Tests in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-04.rs: zlib_reference_bytes_decode_to_hello, every_level_and_algorithm_round_trips, stored_zlib_from_the_png_writer_decodes_through_the_codec. Not yet verified on Midget.

features.apple: BLAS, LAPACK, Sparse Solvers, Solving systems of linear equations
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 2 (theme-36, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No matrix solver or BLAS-style routines. The constraint solver serves layout only.

features.apple: Working with Vectors, Matrices and Quaternions; simd; vForce
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 23 tests. Wave 2 (theme-36, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No public small-vector or quaternion types. vForce-style vector transcendental functions are missing.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/cnn_layers.rs (inference only: Network, lstm_step, gru_step); tests: springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-22.rs
features.note: Forward inference for convolution, pooling, dense, relu, custom and LSTM or GRU steps runs on the CPU and is tested headless. Gap: there is no training API and no descriptor an app can build a network from, and the code is not yet wired into apps or the shell.

features.apple: Biquadratic IIR filters, audio spectrogram sample (vDSP plus vImage)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/biquad.rs (Design, Coefficients, Biquad); springboard/audiod (playback service), springboard/src/media/audioplayer.rs, biquad filter chain in springboard/apps/daw/src/devices/inst/zones/mod.rs
features.note: Low-pass, high-pass and peaking sections with cookbook coefficients, their magnitude response and block processing are tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-os-02.rs. Gap: no spectrogram, and the playback service does not run these filters for apps.

features.apple: Core Video interoperability with vImage pixel buffers
features.note: Plane addressing for the BGRA and NV12 layouts is tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-os-02.rs. Gap: no pixel buffer object is tied to the hardware decoder, so apps cannot take decoded frames.

features.apple: Quadrature (definite integration over finite or infinite intervals)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 2 (theme-36, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No numerical integration routines.

gaps: No SDK module for vDSP, vImage, BNNS, BLAS/LAPACK, sparse solvers or simd.
No app-facing FFT or DCT API. The only FFT is private to the DAW convolver (springboard/apps/daw/src/conv.rs).
No LZFSE, LZ4, LZMA or Brotli codec. The SDK compression module covers DEFLATE and zlib only, and the PNG writer stores uncompressed blocks.
No general image convolution, morphology, histogram, or arbitrary-angle geometric transform API.
No public pixel-format conversion for CMYK or planar formats. Only NV12 and RGBA to RGBA exists, in the media layer.
No neural network inference or training API for apps.
No small-vector, matrix or quaternion types exposed to the SDK.
